scope: Finite-amplitude positive-variable gauge pulse at the exact control time. Boundary safety and duration assessed separately; no full-goal admission.
physical_fields: chi-1, g-1, Ar, Khat+3, Theta, Lambda, alpha-Aref; shift placeholder excluded
comparison_norm: r^2 weighted RMS of physical fields; bulk r<.8 and endpoint r>.9; degree-8 parity interpolation

temporal.interpretation: Each order uses successive differences at the three listed CFL values. Small-step bulk differences may reach the roundoff floor; retain their measured order.
